title: Cloud download consent — definition of done

steps.path: Browse files, open an online-only file, or start a conversation needing online-only instructions
steps.headline: What the completed change must do

rows.statement: Browsing downloads no content and asks no folder permission; online-only files show cloud icons, while local files keep normal previews.
The selected file’s centered download popup offers Download and open; Not now, Escape, or closing declines and restores focus.
The centered file-waiting popup says ‘Downloading file. You may wait or leave this page.’ without a Keep working button.
rows.note: remove "keep working". change copt to "Downloading file. You may wait or leave this page." it shouldn't automatically open if the user has clicked the x on this popup. should only open if the user is waiting on the popup or leaves and clicks the file again.

rows.statement: Closing file waiting prevents automatic opening; the file opens only while its popup remains active or after another explicit file click.
rows.note: remove "keep working". change copt to "Downloading file. You may wait or leave this page." it shouldn't automatically open if the user has clicked the x on this popup. should only open if the user is waiting on the popup or leaves and clicks the file again.

rows.statement: Two compact conversation lines name required files and explain their source, using neutral wording when unknown, without granting folder permission.
Short waiting text stays inside the affected conversation, which starts when its instructions are ready while other conversations remain usable.
A conversation needing online-only project instructions pauses for approval, never downloading or skipping those instructions silently.
Download consent protects YouCoded’s own file reads, including its context display for Claude Code conversations, without adding restrictions to external programs.
